definitions.map: OpenShare 2025 natural-year snapshot retained from C-Map; shares are within listed geographic contributions, not a newly inferred global total.
definitions.five_year: Original report five-country shares plus Other; separate scope from the OpenShare snapshot.
definitions.flow: 60 repository edges,14 source regions and10 destinations. Contains domestic edges. Partial sample, not a global complete matrix.
definitions.top10: Independent China/US source-share table. Original shares preserved; residual 6.76/22.06 percentage points grouped as Other, not inferred countries.
definitions.direction: Developer location → project affiliation; not human migration, money, or dependency adoption.
definitions.chord: Directed chords; arrowhead identifies destination. Arc width reflects inbound plus outbound in the displayed matrix.
definitions.normalization: Flow value mode uses original OpenRank; percentage mode divides each destination by its current included inflow. Source-share dataset uses original share_pct without renormalization.
definitions.simulation: All Figure3 organizational, role and retention values are hypothetical profiles, not measured countries or verified interventions. No causal effect inferred.

missing: Complete global source-target matrix and source windows
Historical organization affiliations and role evidence
geography: Same OpenShare geometry as V/C/I/A maps. China includes Taiwan; no separate Taiwan country node.
